Reduce exposure to Canada-dependent supply chains; favor domestic-manufacturing equities; monitor tariff policy announcements

Reduce exposure to Chinese battery and commodity producers; favor Western energy transition plays with policy support

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $100 and 10Y yield near 5% create a stagflationary pressure. Expect continued bond selloff, equity risk-off, and elevated VIX. FTSE 100 may bounce but global trend is down. Key watch: whether oil breaks $110 or Hormuz situation de-escalates. ECB and Fed policy responses will dominate next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if geopolitical tensions resolve. Energy transition (hydrogen, foldable tech, AI hardware) offers structural growth. However, sustained oil above $100 and 5%+ yields could delay rate cuts into 2027, compressing equity multiples. China overcapacity and trade wars add 6-12 month uncertainty. AI capex cycle remains intact but faces valuation correction risk.
